Package org.osgi.test.cases.tr069todmt.plugins

Class TestDataPlugin

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.tr069todmt.plugins.TestDataPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.DataPlugin, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.ExecPlugin, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.MountPlugin, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.ReadableDataSession, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.ReadWriteDataSession, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.TransactionalDataSession, org.osgi.service.event.EventHandler
public class TestDataPlugin extends Object implements org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.DataPlugin, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.TransactionalDataSession, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.MountPlugin, org.osgi.service.event.EventHandler, org.osgi.service.dmt.spi.ExecPlugin
this is a simplified plugin that also implements all 3 types of Sessions. It is simplified because not all methods are fully implemented.
